conclusion: TurboQuant has no deployable CPU-AVX2 binary path in the May 2026 community forks. The kernels are gated behind CUDA at build time. Re-evaluate when upstream llama.cpp merges TurboQuant (ggml-org/llama.cpp#20969) or a community CPU fork emerges.

evidence.help_grep_turbo: no matches — only standard --cache-type-k / --cache-type-v entries with no 'turbo' variants
evidence.interpretation: Fork's TurboQuant kernels are gated behind CUDA — when built with -DGGML_CUDA=OFF the turbo3/turbo4 cache types are not registered into the cache-type enum and llama-server does not advertise them. The binary is functionally equivalent to upstream llama.cpp's CPU build, just stale.
